The buns in the immediate foreground have slightly irregular, non-uniform shapes that look somewhat melted or deformed rather than like distinct, baked dough structures. The highlights on them are also overly glossy/plastic-like.

The reflections on the glass are complex and somewhat chaotic, which is realistic, but some reflection patterns near the top right seem to blend into the background objects in a way that suggests minor rendering ambiguity.
